programmes.d: Lucy Alexander and Martin Roberts search for auction items to benefit Children in Need.
Philip Serrell and Catherine Southon head from Skipton to Liverpool for their final auction showdown.
The second day of the trip for Mark Stacey and Catherine Southon starts in Glasgow before passing through Falkirk on the way to the auction in Dundee.
It's day one for expert Thomas Plant and Road Trip newbie, Scottish auctioneer Paul Laidlaw, as they travel from Skipton to Sheffield.
Frances Barber and Phil Davis join Catherine Southon and Thomas Plant on a buying spree.
Road trippers Mark Stacey and Catherine Southon start in Dundee and travel through Forfar and Invururie on their way to auction in Aberdeen.
Day two for dynamic duo Thomas Plant and Paul Laidlaw sees them attempt to outwit each other on their way from Bolsover to the auction in Stamford.
Mark Stacey and Catherine Southon begin this leg in Aberdeen before traveling through the Coastal town of Cullen and on to auction at Elgin in Moray.
Edwina Currie rides around Liverpool and Manchester looking for antiques to auction.
It's charm versus mathematical prowess, as experts Thomas Plant and Paul Laidlaw hit the shops between Huntingdon and Towcester.
On the final day of their Scottish Road trip, Mark Stacey and Catherine Southon start in Rait in Perth and Kinross then travel through Dundee and Arbroath before heading to auction in Edinburgh.
Thomas Plant and Paul Laidlaw's negotiating tactics are tested to the limit as they travel from Olney to the auction in Watlington.
Shaun Williamson takes on Vicky Entwistle--in a stunning TVR Chimera.

James Braxton and Helen Hall begin their first leg of the trip in Oswestry in Shropshire, auction in Carmarthen, Carmarthenshire, and then cross the Welsh border towards Montgomery and Machynlleth in Powys.
Thomas Plant and Paul Laidlaw spend their final day of antique adventuring heading from Tetsworth to the final auction showdown in Pewsey.
Judith Chalmers takes on son Mark Durden-Smith, with guides Paul Laidlaw and James Lewis.

It's the second leg of the trip and James Braxton and Helen Hall begin their day in Newport in the county of Gwent. The duo then heads to Cardiff before crossing the English border for auction in Wotton-under-Edge in Gloucestershire.
It's Charlie Ross and Charles Hanson's first day together as they kick off their journey in Bridlington and head to an auction showdown in Doncaster.
Miles Jupp and Nina Wadia search for auction items to benefit Children in Need.
Charlie Ross and Charles Hanson are getting on famously as they drive the second leg of their road trip from Scunthorpe to Grantham.
James Braxton and Helen Hall start their day in the city and county of Bristol before heading to Corsham and Bradford-on-Avon in Wiltshire, and then on to auction in Swindon.
The competition heats up on day three as the two Charlies journey from King's Lynn to the auction in Beccles.
Jodie Kidd and James Martin are off--in a pair of Jaguar E types.
Experts James Braxton and Helen Hall begin the fourth leg of their road trip in Wallingford, Oxfordshire, before traveling to Weybridge in Surry, ending up at an auction in Wokingham in Berkshire.
It's day four of Charlie Ross and Charles Hanson's road trip, heading from Lavenham in Suffolk to Greenwich--until their car breaks down.
The last day of the trip for James Braxton and Helen Hall begins in Hampstead, north London, before heading to Brighton and on to auction in Lewes.
Michaela Strachan and Martin Hughes-Games drive a 1964 MGB and brave the antiques jungle.
The fifth leg of the journey for Charles Hanson and Charlie Ross takes them from Royal Tunbridge Wells to Rye in East Sussex for a final showdown.
On this first leg Anita Manning and James Lewis start out in Deddington, Oxfordshire, then cross into Hertfordshire for auction in St Albans.
Robert Bathurst and Amanda Donohue team up with Philip Serrrell and David Harper.
It's a new chapter as we hit the road with seasoned auctioneers James Braxton and Jonathan Pratt as they travel from Altrincham to Nantwich.
Anita Manning and James Lewis head to the London district of Wimbledon, travel through Molesey in Surrey then to auction near Alresford in Hampshire.
James Braxton and Jonathan Pratt search for bargains while traveling from Leek in Staffordshire to Birmingham.
Janet Ellis and her daughter Sophie Ellis Bextor go from Essex to Yorkshire.
Anita Manning and James Lewis begin near Lacock in Wiltshire, then visit Bath, Frome and Swindon en route to auction in Cirencester, Gloucestershire.
James Braxton and Jonathan Pratt are determined to up their game as they head from Stratford upon Avon to the auction in Frome, Somerset.
Chefs Rosemary Shrager and Jean-Christophe Novelli sift through bargains in Yorkshire.
It's day four of James Braxton and Jonathan Pratt's road trip as they scour local antique shops between Wells and the auction in Crewkerne.
Anita Manning and James Lewis wind through Devon, beginning in Exeter and traveling though Crediton and Torquay, headed for auction in Chudleigh.
Kim Wilde and Diarmuid Gavin cut through the antiques undergrowth.
James Braxton and Jonathan Pratt's fifth leg takes them from Crewkerne in Somerset to Lostwithiel in Cornwall for their final auction showdown.
On their last leg, Anita Manning and James Lewis begin in Dorchester, then travel to Portsmouth and Fareham before their final auction in London.
It's a brand-new week, hitting the road with David Barby and David Harper as they travel all the way from Moy to Omagh in Northern Ireland.
Charlie Ross and Christina Trevanion head out in a VW Campervan, kicking off in Scotland.
It's the start of a new trip for Mark Stacey and Will Axon, traveling through East Sussex, from Hastings to an auction battle in Lewes.
David Barby and David Harper grapple with Euros as they travel from Athlone to Kells in Ireland.
Charlie Ross faces penguins. Christina Trevanion steps on top of the Forth Rail Bridge.
It's day two for Mark Stacey and Will Axon. Beginning in Bilsington, they travel across Kent before ending up at an auction in Sandwich.
David Barby and David Harper have crossed the North Sea to Wales--and now the competition heats up as they travel from Prestatyn to Criccieth.
Charlie Ross is flush with success. Can Christina Trevanion catch him up?
Beginning in the coastal town of Deal in Kent, experts Mark Stacey and Will Axon head west to battle it out at their auction in Chiswick, London.
David Barby's after something quirky, while David Harper's going for the killer deal as they shop from Aberystwyth to the auction in Shrewsbury.
Christina Trevanion and Charlie Ross head to auction in Bourne, Lincolnshire.
Will Axon and Mark Stacey begin in the Crystal Palace before heading to Piccadilly in central London to visit the home of The Kennel Club. The boys then head on to their auction in Southend-on-Sea.
The conclusion of David Barby and David Harper's epic tour begins in Hereford--but who will be crowned king at the auction in Llanelli?
Christina Trevanion has shrunk Charlie Ross’s lead, but is it enough?
Mark Stacey and Will Axon begin the final leg in Gosfield, Essex, through Finchingfield and St Albans, Hertfordshire, and end at auction in Ruislip.
Charles Hanson and David Barby kick off their journey in Lichfield, Staffordshire, and head for an auction showdown in Coventry.
Paul Laidlaw and Margie Cooper begin in Penzance and wind through scenic Cornwall.
It's game on as Charles Hanson and David Barby travel from Malvern to a head-to-head auction in Pewsey Wiltshire.
It's a brand-new trip for veteran Philip Serrell and new boy Tom Scott. They begin in St Buryan then wind their way up towards Wareham in Dorset.
After a victory for Paul Laidlaw, Margie Cooper has a lot of catching up to do in Exeter.
Its day three for Charles Hanson and David Barby as they battle it out from Ross on Wye, Herefordshire, to Frome in Somerset for the auction.
Philip Serrell and Tom Scott start day two in Lostwithiel, then visit the ports of Plymouth and Morwellham quay before an auction in Cornwall.
Margie Cooper studies photography and Paul Laidlaw takes in Farleigh Hungerford Castle.
It's all to play for as Charles Hanson and David Barby travel from Chester in Cheshire hunting antiques for the showdown in North Rode near Congleton.
Paul Laidlaw and Margie Cooper kick off leg four of their trip in South Wales.
Philip Serrell and Tom Scott start their day near Dartmoor at Ashburton. They'll be travelling around Devon before arriving at auction in Chudleigh.
It's neck and neck between Charles Hanson and David Barby on the last leg of their journey from Stafford to Nottingham for the final showdown.
Paul Laidlaw and Margie Cooper begin their last day in Newport, South Wales.
Philip Serrell and Tom Scott begin at Exeter in the county of Devon, then travel through Dorchester before making for an auction at Upwey in Dorset.
Newcomer Margie Cooper battles it out with veteran Mark Stacey, starting the week in Chilham, Kent, and ending at auction in Heathfield, East Sussex.
Thomas Plant and Anita Manning head to auction from Hertfordshire--in a yellow Lotus.
Philip Serrell and Tom Scott start the day in Southampton, then head east through Fareham, Portsmouth and Southsea, to auction at Wareham in Dorset.
It couldn't be closer as Margie Cooper and Mark Stacey go hunting that antique gem, from Rochester in Kent to a showdown in Colchester in Essex.
Thomas Plant and Anita Manning find an inventing family and a history-changing mistake.
Paul Laidlaw and David Harper begin in the town of Windermere, weaving through West Burton and Middleham to auction in East Boldon in Tyne and Wear.
